quotes.text: D209901 reviewer noted that an accidental click outside the LDAP dialog could close it and lose configuration despite its Cancel button. The author set consumeOutsideClicks:false on subdialog managers in both Address Book and Preferences, because that setting applied at page scope. The review also requested no-resize on the search textarea because the dialog itself is fixed-size. This is a user-data protection rule for editable dialogs, scoped to the SubDialog behavior used here.
